name: ctx-kit
description: Session lifecycle toolkit: state lives on disk, sessions are disposable. 5 skills (kickoff/handoff/takeover/status/checkup) + a PreCompact warning hook + a cache-audit script + a digest subagent. The hook only shows a notification before auto-compact; the script only reads local session logs. 会话生命周期工具包：状态在盘上，会话可抛弃。
